title: More Financial Incentives and Charging Points to Encourage Electric Car Usage
what_it_is: More Financial Incentives and Charging Points to Encourage Electric Car Usage

sections.label: Electric cars and charging points
sections.summary: The Ministry incentivises low carbon emission cars through CEVS and evaluates proposals for a nationwide electric car-sharing programme with 2,000 charging points.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Transport (a) what is the Ministry's position on use of electric cars in Singapore; (b) whether there are plans to offer financial incentives to encourage more motorists to use electric cars; and (c) whether the Ministry will install more charging points for electric cars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: And that is why we incentivise low carbon emission cars through the Carbon Emissions-based Vehicle Scheme (CEVS), which we have just had a discussion earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: CEVS is outcome-based and neutral with respect to the type of technology used.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the Economic Development Board (EDB) had earlier issued a Request for Information (ROI) to invite proposals for a nationwide electric car-sharing programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Besides trialling electric car-sharing services, the programme will also see the installation of 2,000 charging points across Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The proposals are in the final stages of evaluation.

sections.label: Electric vehicle trials in Singapore
sections.summary: Besides the 2,000 charging point trial, there are trials for buses, taxis and commercial trucks, and Singapore intends to be an early adopter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In fact, besides the trial project involving 2,000 charging points and car-sharing, we have two other trials which are going on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: One is for buses; one is for taxis, and commercial trucks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We certainly intend Singapore to be among the early adopters, if not among the early pioneers on the use of such technology because we are a city, compact and, especially for electric vehicles, you can cover a long distance with a single charge.
